asset_heavy.reason: Operates manufacturing plants worldwide for 40+ brands of heavy equipment; growth requires ongoing plant and inventory investment.

big_ticket.reason: Vacuum trucks, excavators, sweepers and tractor mowers are costly machines bought infrequently on replacement cycles.

cyclical_demand.reason: Municipalities, contractors and farmers can defer equipment purchases; machinery is postponable in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are many municipalities, small contractors and farmers via dealers, not mainly large enterprises.

notes: Parts and service exist but are secondary to equipment sales; some agricultural buyers are individual farmers.

offers_products.reason: Manufactures industrial and vegetation management equipment: vacuum trucks, sweepers, mowers, snow removal equipment.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from equipment; service and parts are incidental support to products sold.

people_delivered.reason: Manufacturer of equipment; value is in the goods, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from one-off equipment sales on replacement cycles, with parts a smaller share.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to municipalities, contractors, utilities and agricultural professionals, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Municipalities, contractors, utilities and dealers buy its equipment.
